# GitHub Copilot — Interplanetary Fund (canonical, updated 2026-11-20)

This file has a **distinct GitHub Copilot discovery purpose**. Keep it at this exact path even when AGENTS.md or another tool's skill file contains similar instructions.

Before modifying anything, read `AGENTS.md`, `BUILD_AGENT_RULES.md`, `PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md`, and `docs/architecture/IFUND_BUILD_CONTRACT_2026-11-03.md`. Resolve disagreement using verified current production evidence and the owner's latest decisions.

- Canonical repository: `interplanetarysister/InterplanetaryFund`; canonical web application: `apps/web`. Active platform: Cloudflare Pages/Workers/R2 plus Supabase Auth/Postgres/RLS, GitHub and approved payment providers. Base44 is a read-only functional reference. Retired Convex/Vercel/backend repositories are **not** active infrastructure.
- **Never delete or merge similarly named files or repositories solely because they appear duplicated.** Verify each separate purpose, consumer, owner, runtime and reference. If unknown, preserve it. Historical migration records are not operational deployment instructions.
- Read current source, configuration, deployments and schema before changing. Never infer that a published build proves working OAuth, AI, RLS, payments or live agent actions.
- Protect personal data and secrets; do not use live financial data for synthetic tests. External actions need verified member consent and provider authorization. Financial truth requires signed provider evidence and idempotent ledger logic; retain the existing 3% fee only at withdrawal for first-party transactions.
- Prefer no-cost, mobile-first, simple user experiences. Keep GitHub Actions disabled when monthly minutes are exhausted. Use reviewed tests and manual preview releases; production requires the appropriate verified release authorization. Do not activate paid integrations.
- Do the work: implement, test, repair, review, integrate, deploy when authorized and verify the actual intended user action. A PR or commit is not completion. Distinguish implemented / verified / blocked.
- Preserve strategically located guides and skills: `.opencode/skills/ifund-browser-access/SKILL.md` is for the developer's local Playwright runner, whereas `docs/agents/skills/browser-access/SKILL.md` is a website-agent research policy **not yet registered as a live tool**.

This instruction set supersedes this path's retired August 2026 Convex/Vercel guidance. Retain historical snapshots in Git history; never restore obsolete credential endpoints as active.
